mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account (account_number, password, balance, member_id, created_at) VALUES (#{accountNumber}, #{password}, #{balance}, #{memberId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_number, password, balance, member_id, created_at, updated_at FROM account WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET balance = #{balance}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.account_number, m.user_name AS owner_name FROM account a JOIN member m ON m.id = a.member_id WHERE a.account_number = #{accountNumber}
